The two streams are separated by a persistent 1px `#e5e5e5` vertical rule.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px)**: Reflows to single-stream stacking; the lead package commands full width while the wire feed transitions to a modular horizontal scroll or secondary partitioned stack below.
- **Mobile (< 768px)**: Fluid, single-column full bleed with `1rem` outer margins. Story packages stack sequentially with distinct 1px horizontal division lines.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system rejects skeuomorphic shadows, ambient drop-shadows, and heavy blurred glassmorphism. Depth is entirely structural and planar, conveyed through hairline borders, precise containment, and subtle surface shifts.

- **Planar Hierarchy**: Depth is defined via 1px solid hairline borders (`#e5e5e5`). Components never "float" via diffuse shadow blurs; they are locked into visual cells.
- **Surface Layering**: The primary canvas is `#ffffff`. Secondary contextual containers—such as quick-reads, live updates, pull quotes, and specs callouts—shift down to `#f8f8f8` or `#121212` for inverted modules.
- **Interaction Depth**: Hover states introduce no Z-axis movement. Instead, interactive items shift border colors to `#121212` or invert backgrounds to `#5200ff` with crisp foreground changes.
- **Modals & Overlays**: Modals utilize a stark, flat `#121212` border with a 100% flat high-contrast shadow offset: `4px 4px 0px 0px #121212`, avoiding all gradient blurs.

## Shapes

The shape vocabulary is strictly brutalist and sharp (`roundedness: 0`). 

- Every corner across the system carries a precise `0px` radius: cards, interactive buttons, contextual tags, image frames, input containers, and flyout menus.
- Sharp geometry preserves the architectural rhythm of traditional print mastheads and high-density financial/news tickers.
- Media elements (images, embedded video, interactive figures) must bleed to crisp zero-radius boundaries without pill treatment or soft corner feathering.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Sharp rectangular box with `#121212` background, white text in `label-lg`, zero corner radius. On hover: shifts background to `#5200ff`.
- **Secondary / Outlined**: Transparent background with 1px hairline `#121212` border. On hover: inverts completely to `#121212` background and white text.
- **Accent (Breaking/Live)**: `#5200ff` solid background with pure white typography.
- **Ghost**: No border, monospaced typography with an immediate rightward arrow indicator (`->`). Hover reveals an energetic `#5200ff` bottom underline (2px).

### Chips & Category Tags
- Rendered in `label-sm` or `label-md` with `Space Mono`.
- Uppercase text with tight vertical padding (`0.25rem 0.5rem`).
- Bordered with 1px `#e5e5e5` hairline or filled with subtle `#f2f2f2` background and `#121212` text.
- Live / Breaking tags feature a pulsating 6px `#ff385c` circular pip beside the tag label.

### Chronological Wire List ('Latest / Following')
- Dense stacked list items separated by 1px `#eaeaea` borders.
- Each item leads with a monospaced timestamp (e.g., `14:22 ET`) in `#767676`.
- Headline rendered in `Work Sans` Bold (`body-sm` or `body-md`), transitioning to `#5200ff` on title hover.
- Author byline paired with comment count badge pinned to the right edge.

### Form Inputs & Text Fields
- 1px hairline border in `#121212` or `#e5e5e5`, sharp corners (`0px`), zero shadows.
- Inner padding: `0.75rem 1rem`.
- Monospaced field labels (`label-md`) situated above the field.
- Active focus state: explicit 2px border rendered in `#5200ff`.

### Checkboxes & Radio Buttons
- Checkboxes: 16px square (`0px` radius) with 1px `#121212` border. Checked state renders full `#5200ff` fill with a sharp white checkmark.
- Radio buttons: 16px circular boundary; selected state features an interior concentric circle in `#5200ff`.

### Editorial Cards
- **Feature Lead Card**: Dominates the left editorial stream. Hero image spanning 16:9 ratio, bordered with a hairline bottom edge, followed by an oversized display headline (`headline-lg` / `Anton`), author timestamp byline, and excerpt.
- **Standard Story Card**: Compact horizontal card with a 1:1 square thumbnail pinned to the right, headline on the left, tagged above by monospaced category metadata.

### Mastheads & Section Dividers
- Black-and-white structural ribbons running horizontally across section breaks.
- Contains all-caps category typography flanked by 1px solid continuous dividing lines spanning 100% of the canvas grid width.
